items.title: Availability Blocks expanded
items.summary: Multiple occupancy levels and rates per space category, pick-up tracked by category/occupancy, product rules inherited from parent rate, add existing reservation groups to a block, updated Availability Block Report, connected spaces in availability calculations.
items.pitch: Less manual reconciliation for group bookings.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. All users except Strawberry properties.

items.title: Trial Balance for any period in Mews Operations
items.summary: Trial Balance is now a native report in Mews Operations for weekly, monthly or custom periods (no longer only daily exports); export to Excel, CSV or PDF. Release note posted 30 Sep; the public changelog still lists it as coming soon.
items.pitch: Reconcile a whole month in one report.
items.segmentation: Tier 2. Segmented to US, Canada, Mexico, Panama, Bonaire/St Eustatius/Saba, Costa Rica, Curaçao, Singapore, Puerto Rico.

items.title: Mews Automations is GA
items.summary: Build, run and monitor workflows with the Workflow Creator (triggers, filters, actions), performance/monitoring view, and three templates (room upgrades, amenity gifts, personalised upsell offers).
items.pitch: Lead with the three templates as the quick win; the monitoring view builds trust.
items.segmentation: Tier 1. Available to all Mews Operations users under Automations in the main menu.

items.title: Guest Messaging is GA
items.summary: One inbox in Mews Operations for SMS, WhatsApp, Booking.com, Expedia and more; reply without leaving Mews, AI can draft replies.
items.pitch: Lead with time saved and no more missed messages.
items.segmentation: Tier 1. Requires the Advanced Guest Experience module.

items.title: Germany e-invoicing via Peppol
items.summary: Send compliant e-invoices (Peppol/XRechnung) to businesses and public bodies from Mews Operations; created automatically on bill close, with delivery status in the Fiscal Record Report. Runs alongside existing XRechnung integrations.
items.pitch: Compliance happens as part of closing a bill; low-cost add-on ahead of the 2027/2028 mandate.
items.segmentation: Tier 2. Germany only; opt-in via Mews Marketplace (Compliance Suite), EUR 25/property/month.

items.title: Italy e-invoicing (SdI)
items.summary: Mews generates the FatturaPA invoice and submits it to SdI on bill close; no certificate needed; delivery status in the Fiscal Record Report. Covers domestic B2B, B2G, B2C. Runs alongside the legacy integration.
items.pitch: Close the bill and Mews does the rest. SdI confirmation can take up to 24h, so do not promise instant confirmation.
items.segmentation: Tier 2. Italy only; Compliance Suite, EUR 25/property/month.

items.title: Accounts Receivable reminder templates and history
items.summary: Edit 4 reusable invoice reminder templates and review the full history of payment reminders sent per invoice and account.
items.pitch: Set wording once, reuse everywhere; history prevents chasing the same invoice twice.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. Properties eligible for the Accounts Receivable package.

items.title: Bulk edit pricing: custom prices and RMS price hierarchies per date
items.summary: Bulk price editing in Mews RMS can now set a unique custom price or RMS price hierarchy for each date in one edit, instead of one value across the whole range.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. Available to all Mews RMS users.

items.title: Expired inquiries/options no longer counted as no-shows
items.summary: Jira release-note ticket TW-2715 (Done) describes inquired/optional/requested reservations that expire being cancelled as "Confirmation missed" instead of "No show", so reports show genuine no-shows only. Ticket has no ReleaseNote label and no Slack or changelog post, so publication is unconfirmed.
items.segmentation: 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers.

Not seen in #prod-roadmap-updates, Jira release tickets or the public changelog, so treat as unconfirmed. A public campaign page exists on mews.com, but no release note has been posted yet.

items.title: Events rebuild in the PMS — timeline
items.summary: Internal working assumptions: Alpha late Nov 2026 (4–5 design partners, not for sale), Beta first half Q1 2027 (demos/selling start), GA soft launch late Q1 2027. Dates are not commitments — do not hard-commit to customers. Hold the line on external demos; the teaser video may be shared 1:1 only, not on socials. Legacy Mews Events stays in maintenance mode.

items.title: Mews AI naming: Navigator dropped
items.summary: LT decision (#rnd, 9 Oct): not moving forward with the name Navigator. Mews AI is the umbrella; domain products are "[Domain] AI" (e.g. Revenue AI, Guest Experience AI); capabilities are named for what they do (e.g. Automations Builder). Avoid Agent, Copilot, Coworker and Navigator in naming. Use the new terms if talking about AI features internally.
items.segmentation: 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers.

items.title: Billing visibility at check-out (UK first)
items.summary: Draft release note (Jira TW-2703, no ReleaseNote label, not yet in #prod-roadmap-updates or the public changelog): check-out dialog lists the bills on the reservations, flags unbalanced bills blocking check-out, and lets staff add/change the email address bills are sent to. Planned phased rollout: UK 12 Oct, then other English-language European markets, then GA. Wait for the public release note before telling customers.
